description:
Rewrite the Beadwork parent prompt appendix for goal mode and interactive mode. No supervisor language.

## Background

`prompt.ts` currently tells the parent it is in run mode and to delegate against ready tickets via beadwork worker tools. New run mode: standing appendix is policy only (does not start a turn). Tell the parent to use `orchestrate` + beadwork start/close/comment; do not poll; do not close from child settlement; compose the child `task` string yourself; include domain metadata; default ticket review; file is nonblocking unless the user waives; quality commands are the implementer's/reviewer's job.

Interactive mode stays human-led: no injected go-prompt, no autonomous fleet.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/prompt.ts`
- tests

## Child task composition guidance

The parent (not a wrap hook) writes `task`. Include ticket/epic facts, "do not close tickets", shared-checkout discipline, encourage a prose handoff (summary, commits, commands run, blockers). Do not claim a schema.

Review children: inspect commits/ticket id/git show, not "read the whole dirty workspace". Do not start review of A while A's implementer is still live (instruction, not a lock).

## Success criteria

- Appendix contains orchestrate + start-before-work + settlement≠close.
- Appendix does not mention tmux, delegate, worker_done, landing, --workers.
- Neutral mode still returns undefined appendix.

## Test plan

- Unit: snapshots/strings for run vs interactive vs neutral.
- Unit: review policy text differs for ticket/scope/none.

## Considerations

Do not inject a turn from this module. Injection is `/bw run` in actions/run.ts.
title: Rewrite Beadwork goal-mode prompt appendix for orchestrate
